name: MEGA
tagline: Fast, encrypted cloud storage with 20 GB permanent free tier and S4 Object Storage.

instructions.step1: Select your preferred connection method: Personal Cloud Drive (20 GB Free) or S4 Object Storage.
instructions.step2: Enter your account login credentials or S4 API keys.
instructions.step3: Your virtual drive will mount immediately to ~/Mega.

methods.name: MEGA Cloud Drive (Personal)
methods.description: Direct access to your standard personal MEGA cloud drive files (20 GB permanent free tier).
methods.disclosure: Note: You must log into mega.nz via a web browser at least once before connecting so your encryption keys are initialized. 2FA must be disabled on MEGA for direct Rclone connection.

instructions.step1: Enter your registered MEGA account email address and account password.
instructions.step2: Ensure you have logged into mega.nz in a web browser at least once to generate account encryption keys.
instructions.step3: Ensure Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) is turned OFF on your MEGA account for direct rclone support.

fields.label: MEGA Account Email
fields.helper: The email address associated with your MEGA account

methods.name: MEGA S4 Object Storage (S3)
methods.description: High-performance S3-compliant object storage with Access Key and Secret Key authentication.

instructions.step1: Open MEGA S4 settings at https://mega.nz/fm/account/s4 to create an Access Key and Secret Key.
instructions.step2: Enter your Access Key ID, Secret Access Key, and target S4 endpoint.
instructions.step3: Your S4 bucket will mount natively to ~/Mega-S4 via high-performance S3 protocol.

fields.label: MEGA S4 Endpoint URL
fields.helper: Global or regional S4 endpoint URL (default: https://s3.g.s4.mega.io)

fields.label: Bucket Name (Optional)
fields.helper: Target S4 bucket name (leave empty to mount all buckets)

fields.label: S4 Access Key ID
fields.helper: Access Key ID generated in MEGA S4 settings

fields.label: S4 Secret Access Key
fields.helper: Secret Access Key generated in MEGA S4 settings
